title: Huiyu Image Tools
description:
═══════════════════════════════════════

 

 Huiyu Image Tools

 

 All-in-One Image Toolkit

 

═══════════════════════════════════════

 

 

16 powerful image tools in one app. 100% local processing. Your privacy, protected.

 

A comprehensive image toolkit combining editing, format conversion, and color design. All operations run locally on your computer - images never leave your device. Your privacy always comes first.

 

 

🖼️ Image Editing 

📐 Image Resizer 

Resize images by pixels, percentage, or aspect ratio. Batch process multiple images in one go.

 

 🎯 Multiple modes —— Pixels / percentage / aspect ratio / custom dimensions

 📦 Batch processing —— Resize multiple images at once

 🎨 Quality preserved —— Smart interpolation for crisp results

 💾 Format support —— JPG / PNG / WebP and more

 

✂️ Image Cropper 

Free crop, fixed aspect ratio, or preset sizes. Crop exactly how you want it.

 

 🆓 Free crop —— Drag selection, totally flexible

 📏 Aspect lock —— 1:1 / 4:3 / 16:9 and more presets

 📱 Social presets —— Popular social media sizes ready to use

 🔍 Pixel-perfect —— Keyboard fine-tuning for precision

 

📦 Image Compressor 

Dramatically reduce file size while maintaining visual quality. Save storage space instantly.

 

 ⚡ Lightning fast —— Local processing, done in seconds

 🎚️ Quality slider —— Real-time preview of compression

 📊 Size comparison —— Before/after sizes at a glance

 🔄 Batch compress —— Multiple images, one click

 

✨ Image Sharpener 

Bring blurry photos into focus. Enhance details and make images pop.

 

 🔍 Smart sharpen —— Edge-aware, only sharpens details

 🎚️ Adjustable intensity —— Mild / medium / strong

 🖼️ Live preview —— Side-by-side comparison

 💾 Lossless export —— High-quality output

 

🧹 Watermark Remover 

AI-powered inpainting removes watermarks, text, and blemishes. Restore clean, natural-looking images.

 

 🎨 Brush tool —— Manually mark areas to remove

 🤖 Smart repair —— AI fills in surrounding textures

 🖌️ Adjustable brush —— Multiple sizes for precision

 📸 Natural results —— Smooth, seamless restoration

 

🎯 SnapResize Smart Crop 

AI detects the main subject and keeps it in frame when cropping. Every pixel counts.

 

 🧠 Smart composition —— Face/subject detection, auto-centered

 📐 Any ratio —— Set target dimensions freely

 ⚡ One-click results —— Upload and go

 🎬 Thumbnail magic —— Perfect for e-commerce & social

 

🔄 Rotate & Flip 

Rotate by any angle, flip horizontally or vertically. Fix orientation in seconds.

 

 🔃 Free rotation —— 0-360 degrees, any angle

 ↔️ Flip horizontal —— Mirror left-right

 ↕️ Flip vertical —— Mirror top-bottom

 ⚡ Quick 90° —— One-click left/right rotation

 

🖼️ Image Collage 

Combine multiple photos into one. Horizontal, vertical, or grid layouts — unleash your creativity.

 

 ➡️ Horizontal —— Side by side

 ⬇️ Vertical —— Stacked top to bottom

 🔲 Grid layout —— Rows and columns, freely combined

 📏 Adjustable gaps —— Spacing & borders, fully customizable

 

✏️ Image Annotator 

Text, arrows, shapes, mosaics - rich annotation tools for crystal-clear communication.

 

 🔤 Text labels —— Fonts, colors, sizes galore

 ➡️ Arrow markers —— Point to what matters

 🟥 Shape highlights —— Rectangles, circles, freehand

 🧩 Pixel mosaic —— Blur out sensitive info instantly

 

🔄 Conversion & Metadata 

 

🔀 Format Converter 

Convert between JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, ICO and more. Batch mode for maximum efficiency.

 

 🎨 Multi-format —— JPG / PNG / WebP / BMP / TIFF

 🔄 Batch convert —— Whole folders in one operation

 🎚️ Quality control —— Compression level adjustable

 📂 Folder structure preserved —— Organized output

 

📋 EXIF Viewer 

Inspect photo metadata - camera info, lens specs, GPS location, and more.

 

 📷 Camera info —— Body / lens / aperture / shutter / ISO

 🗺️ GPS data —— See where the photo was taken

 📅 Timestamps —— Capture time & modification date

 📤 One-click copy —— Copy data to clipboard instantly

 

🔖 Favicon Generator 

Generate multi-size ICO icons for websites, apps, and folders in one click.

 

 🎯 Multi-size output —— 16/32/48/64/128/256 px

 💻 Website favicon —— Generate favicon.ico instantly

 📁 Folder icons —— Customize your folder look

 ⚡ One-click generation —— Upload, get full icon pack

 

🎨 Color Design Tools 

 

🎨 Palette Generator 

Automatically extract dominant colors from any image. Generate harmonious color schemes effortlessly.

 

 🖼️ Image-based —— Upload an image, get its palette

 🌈 Multiple schemes —— Several options to choose from

 🔢 HEX/RGB/HSL —— Copy values in any format

 💾 Export & share —— Save and share your palettes

 

🎯 Color Match 

Transfer the color style of one image to another. Unify your visual aesthetic.

 

 🎨 Style transfer —— Apply reference tone to target image

 📊 Histogram matching —— Precise brightness & color distribution

 ⚡ Live preview —— See results instantly

 💾 HD export —— High-quality download

 

💧 Color Picker 

Pick colors from anywhere on screen. Get precise color values - a designer's best friend.

 

 🎯 Pixel-perfect —— Magnified view for accuracy

 🔢 Multi-format output —— HEX / RGB / HSL / HSV

 📋 History —— Auto-saves picked colors

 ⌨️ Shortcut —— Summon anytime, maximum efficiency

 

🤖 AI Color Scheme 

Enter one color, let AI generate a complete palette. Endless design inspiration.

 

 🧠 AI-powered —— Smart, harmonious color generation

 🌈 Multiple modes —— Complementary / analogous / triadic / split and more

 🎨 Real-time preview —— See schemes instantly

 💾 One-click copy —— Grab values and go

 

🚀 Features 

 

🔒 Privacy First 

All image processing happens on your device. Your data never leaves your computer.

 

 💾 Local only —— Zero image uploads to any server

 🔐 Privacy guaranteed —— Process sensitive photos with confidence

 ⚡ Blazing fast —— Local computation, no network waits

 🚫 No tracking —— We collect zero user data

 

⌨️ Command Palette 

Ctrl+K to summon. Search and launch any tool instantly. Keyboard lovers rejoice.

 

 🔍 Global search —— Find any tool in milliseconds

 ⌨️ Keyboard-driven —— Full keyboard, no mouse needed

 📊 Smart ranking —— Frequently used tools first

 ⚡ Instant response —— Zero delay, zero waiting

 

📥 Download Center 

Manage all your results in one place. Batch download everything with a single click.

 

 📦 Unified management —— All output files in one view

 🔽 Batch download —— Zip and download all at once

 📊 Progress tracking —— Real-time processing status

 🗂️ History —— Revisit past work anytime

 

🌍 Bilingual Support 

Simplified Chinese and English. For users around the world.

 

 🇨🇳 简体中文 —— Native-level experience

 🇺🇸 English —— Fluent English interface

 🔄 One-click switch —— Change language anytime

 🌐 Many languages

 

🖱️ Native Drag & Drop 

Drag image files right into the window. Automatically opens the right tool. Intuitive and fast.

 

 📂 Drag files in —— Drop into window, start working

 🔗 Smart matching —— Auto-selects the best tool for the job

 📁 Batch drag —— Drop multiple images at once

 ⚡ Instant load —— Zero waiting, instant results

 

🎮 Steam Integration 

Exclusive Steam experience. Rich Presence shows friends which tool you're using.

 

 👤 User recognition —— Shows current Steam user info

 🎯 Rich Presence —— Friends see what you're working on

 🛒 Store link —— One click to more Huiyu products

 🔌 Graceful fallback —— Works fine without Steam running

 

⚡ Lightweight & Fast 

Built with Tauri. Tiny installer, lightning-fast startup, minimal resource usage.

 

 📦 Tiny size —— Installer is only ~18 MB

 🚀 Instant startup —— Click and it's open

 💾 Low memory —— Barely any footprint in background

 🖼️ Native feel —— Smooth desktop experience

 

═══════════════════════════════════════

 

 

16 image tools. One powerful app.

 

Local. Private. Lightning fast.

 

 

═══════════════════════════════════════
description_short: Image Toolkit: 16 image tools in one app — resize, crop, compress, watermark removal, collage, color picker, and more. All-in-one solution. Local processing, privacy-protected, lightweight and clean.
